name: Sweet Chili Pork & Cabbage Stir-Fry

freezer.tip: Freeze the pork only; the cabbage gets soggy.

steps: Simmer rice with 3/4 cup water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Slice scallions (keep whites and greens apart). Stir together chili sauce, ponzu, half the vinegar, 2 1/2 tbsp sweet soy glaze and the sugar.
Soften scallion whites in oil. Add pork and garlic powder, press flat and brown 3-4 min, then break up and cook through. Stir in the sauce for 1 min.
Add cabbage mix and cook 2-3 min. Fluff rice with butter, top with the stir-fry, scallion greens and crispy onions.

name: Firecracker Meatballs

freezer.tip: Freeze baked meatballs without the sauce. Mix the sauce fresh.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Mince scallion whites and ginger; slice greens.
Mix mayo, sour cream, honey, 2 tsp soy sauce and sriracha to taste for the sauce.
Simmer rice with 3/4 cup water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Combine beef, panko, scallion whites, ginger, remaining soy sauce, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper; roll 10-12 meatballs.
Roast meatballs and oiled green beans on one sheet, 14-16 min.
Toss meatballs in the sauce; serve over rice with beans and scallion greens.

name: Banh Mi-Style Turkey Meatball Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze baked meatballs only. Make the salad and mayo fresh.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Mince ginger and garlic, slice cucumber, chop cilantro, zest and quarter lime.
Cook half the ginger in butter, add rice, 3/4 cup water and salt; simmer covered 15-18 min.
Mix turkey, panko, ponzu, garlic, remaining ginger, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper; form 10-12 meatballs and roast 14-16 min.
Toss cucumber, carrots, half the cilantro and lime juice/zest. Mix mayo with lime juice and half the chili sauce.
Stir 2 1/2 tbsp sweet soy glaze, sugar and remaining chili sauce; toss the hot meatballs in it.
Serve meatballs over rice with the salad, chili-lime mayo and cilantro.

name: Tex-Mex Turkey Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze the cooked turkey filling; make the rice and salsa fresh.

steps: Simmer rice with 3/4 cup water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Slice onion (mince 2 tbsp), drain and chop pineapple (keep the juice), chop cilantro, zest and quarter lime, slice pepper.
Mix minced onion, pineapple, half the cilantro and lime juice for salsa.
Cook sliced onion and pepper with half the spice blend until browned, 7-9 min; set aside.
Brown turkey, then stir in Tex-Mex paste, remaining spice blend and pineapple juice; simmer 2-3 min.
Fluff rice with lime zest, cilantro and butter. Top with turkey, veggies, salsa and crema.

name: Turkey, Gouda & Apple Sandwiches
steps: Toast the bread. Core and thinly slice the apple.
Stir mayo, Dijon and a pinch of sugar into Dijonnaise.
Spread on the bread, layer gouda, turkey and apple, close and halve. Serve extra apple on the side.

name: Pork & Zucchini Bibimbap
steps: Simmer rice with 1 1/4 cups water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Slice scallions (whites apart), shave carrots into ribbons, slice zucchini into half-moons, mince ginger and garlic.
Pickle scallion whites in vinegar with a pinch of salt. Whisk sesame oil, half the soy sauce, the sugar and sriracha to taste.
Cook carrots 3-4 min, then zucchini until browned; set aside.
Brown pork with ginger and garlic, then add remaining soy sauce until mostly absorbed.
Top rice with pork, carrots and zucchini, then pickled scallions, sauce and scallion greens.

name: Meatloaves with Creamy Thyme Sauce

freezer.tip: Freeze shaped raw loaves or cooked ones. Sides and sauce are best fresh.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice potatoes, slice half the shallot and mince the rest, halve sprouts. Boil potatoes until tender, 15-20 min; save 1/2 cup water.
Mix beef, panko, minced shallot, half the garlic powder and 1 tbsp water with salt and pepper; shape two 1-inch-tall loaves.
Roast loaves and oiled sprouts on one sheet, 15-20 min.
Soften chopped thyme and sliced shallot, add stock concentrate and 1/4 cup water, simmer 2-3 min, then stir in half the sour cream and 1 tbsp butter.
Mash potatoes with remaining sour cream, garlic powder and butter, loosening with cooking water.
Plate and spoon the sauce over the meatloaves.

name: Tex-Mex Turkey Stuffed Peppers

freezer.tip: Freeze the turkey-rice filling; stuff fresh-roasted peppers.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Slice a quarter of the onion and dice the rest; halve and seed peppers; mince garlic.
Quick-pickle sliced onion with juice of half the lime, the sugar and salt (microwave 30 sec).
Simmer rice with 3/4 cup water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Oil the pepper halves and roast cut side down, 15-18 min.
Soften diced onion, then brown turkey with garlic and spice blend. Stir in tomato paste, stock concentrates and 1/3 cup water; simmer 1-2 min. Fold in buttered rice.
Stuff peppers, nestle into the pan with leftover filling, top with cheese and bake 3-4 min. Serve with pickled onion and crema.

name: Spiced Turkey & Chickpea Tagine

freezer.tip: Freeze the stew; make the rice and lemon crema fresh.

steps: Zest and quarter lemon, cut zucchini into quarter-moons, slice onion, mince garlic.
Simmer rice with 3/4 cup water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Stir sour cream with lemon juice, zest and salt, thinning with water to drizzle.
Brown zucchini 2-3 min; set aside.
Brown turkey with onion and spice blend, add garlic and zucchini, then chickpeas with their liquid and stock concentrates. Reduce by half, 2-3 min, and finish with lemon juice.
Serve over rice with the lemon crema.

name: Shawarma-Spiced Grilling Cheese
steps: Slice shallot (mince 2 tbsp), mince garlic, chop pistachios, slice cucumber, halve tomatoes, zest and quarter lemon.
Cook minced shallot, half the garlic, half the pistachios and half the spice blend in 1 tbsp butter for 1 min. Add rice, stock concentrate and 3/4 cup water; simmer covered 15-18 min.
Toss cucumber, tomatoes and sliced shallot with olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper. Mix sour cream with the rest of the garlic, thinned with water.
Slice the cheese into four pieces and coat with remaining spice blend.
Sear cheese in oil until golden, 1-2 min per side.
Fluff rice with butter, top with salad and cheese, drizzle with garlic sauce and hot sauce, finish with pistachios.

name: Mushroom Ravioli in a Tomato Cream Sauce
steps: Boil a pot of salted water. Halve larger tomatoes. Season ricotta with 1 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper.
Soften tomatoes in olive oil with half the Italian seasoning, 2-3 min. Stir in stock concentrate, cream cheese, half the marinara and 1/4 cup water; simmer until thick, 1-3 min.
Cook ravioli 3-4 min; save 1/4 cup pasta water.
Toss ravioli and butter in the sauce, loosening with pasta water. Top with ricotta.

name: Mexican Chicken & Rice Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze the cooked chicken and peppers; make the rice and toppings fresh.

steps: Boil 3/4 cup water with stock concentrate, half the spice blend and the turmeric. Add rice and salt; simmer covered 15-18 min.
Slice pepper, dice tomato, slice scallions, zest and quarter lime.
Cook pepper 2-3 min. Add chicken seasoned with remaining spice blend; cook 4-6 min. Stir in Tex-Mex paste and 1/4 cup water until thick, then 1 tbsp butter.
Mix tomato, scallions and lime for salsa; mix sour cream with lime zest and juice.
Fluff rice with butter, top with chicken, salsa, lime sour cream and hot sauce.

name: Garlicky Fried Chicken Sandwiches

freezer.tip: Freeze the breaded raw cutlets; fry or air fry from frozen with a few extra minutes.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut carrots into fry-shaped sticks. Mix panko, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper.
Roast oiled carrots 15-20 min.
Pound chicken to 1/2 inch, season, brush with sour cream and press into the panko mix.
Shallow-fry in 1/3 inch of oil until golden and cooked through, 3-5 min per side (or air fry at 390°F, 6 min per side).
Whisk mayo, honey Dijon and hot sauce. Toast buns.
Build sandwiches with the sauce and serve with carrots.

name: Belgian Waffles with Maple-Pear Compote

freezer.tip: The compote freezes well; the parfaits don't.

steps: Dice the pear and quarter the lemon.
Melt butter, add pear, cinnamon, brown sugar, half the maple syrup, 1/4 cup water, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Simmer until soft, 10-12 min, then mash until chunky.
Whisk yogurt, crème fraîche and remaining maple syrup; top with almonds and cranberries.
Toast waffles and spoon the compote over them. Serve the parfaits alongside.

name: Warm Buttered Shrimp Rolls
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut potatoes into wedges, zest and halve lemon, slice scallions (whites apart).
Roast potatoes with olive oil, half the paprika and half the garlic powder, 20-25 min.
Stir mayo, sour cream, half the lemon juice, half the celery salt and the sugar; toss with cabbage and scallion greens.
Split baguettes, brush with melted butter and toast 2-3 min.
Toss shrimp with olive oil and the remaining spices; cook with scallion whites 3-4 min, then stir in butter and lemon zest.
Fill rolls with shrimp and slaw. Serve with the wedges.

name: Street Cart-Style Chicken Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze the raw spice-rubbed chicken. Make the rice and sauce fresh.

steps: Bloom turmeric in 1 tbsp butter, then add rice, 3/4 cup water, stock concentrate and salt; simmer covered 15-18 min.
Soften 2 tbsp butter. Quarter lemon, slice scallions (whites apart), dice tomato.
Stir sour cream, mayo, garlic powder and lemon juice into a white sauce, thinning with water.
Season chicken with the shawarma blend; cook with scallion whites 4-6 min.
Warm pitas, butter them and cut into wedges.
Fluff rice with half the scallion greens. Top with chicken and tomato, drizzle with white sauce and hot sauce. Serve with pita.

name: Sweet & Spicy Avocado Toasts with Feta
steps: Halve and toast the ciabattas.
Slice cucumber on a diagonal and dress with olive oil, salt and pepper. Chop the dill.
Spread toast with guacamole, add cucumber and drizzle with jam. Top with feta, dill, fried onions and chili flakes.
note: Card gives red pepper jam and fried onions as 1 packet each, with no size.

name: Steak with Mushroom Cream Sauce
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice potatoes, cut carrots on a diagonal, slice mushrooms, mince garlic, slice scallions (whites apart).
Roast potatoes and carrots with olive oil, 20-25 min.
Brown mushrooms in olive oil and butter, 5-7 min; set aside.
Season steak and sear to your liking, 4-7 min per side. Let it rest.
In the same pan, cook garlic and scallion whites in butter, add stock concentrate and 1/4 cup water, then mushrooms and steak juices. Off heat, stir in sour cream.
Slice steak against the grain and serve with veggies and sauce.

name: Quick & Cheesy Scrambled Egg Migas Tacos
steps: Slice scallions (whites apart) and crush the chips.
Whisk part of the sour cream with 1 tsp water, then the eggs, scallion whites, half the spice blend, salt and pepper.
Microwave covered, stirring halfway, until just set, 1-2 min. Stir in half the cheese.
Warm tortillas, fill with the rest of the cheese, then eggs, chips and drained pico.
Top with scallion greens, the remaining sour cream and hot sauce.

name: Prosciutto & Mozzarella Sandwiches
steps: Slice tomato and mozzarella into 1/4-inch rounds; season tomato.
Halve ciabattas, drizzle with olive oil and toast if you like.
Spread with mayo, layer tomato, prosciutto and mozzarella, drizzle with balsamic glaze and close. Makes a good packed lunch.

name: Sizzling Garlic Herb Butter Steak
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Soften 4 tbsp butter. Cut potatoes into wedges and carrots on a diagonal.
Roast potatoes tossed with oil and fry seasoning beside oiled carrots, 20-25 min.
Cook garlic and thyme in oil 1-2 min, then mash into the softened butter with the Worcestershire and pepper.
Sear steak 3-6 min per side, basting with 1 tbsp of the herb butter at the end. Let it rest.
Warm peas in 1 tbsp butter, then stir in roasted carrots and honey.
Slice steak and top with more herb butter.

name: Pork Sausage & Pea Risotto
steps: Simmer 4 cups water with the stock concentrates. Mince shallot, zest and quarter lemon.
Brown sausage, broken up, 5-7 min; lift out and keep the fat in the pan.
Soften shallot in 1 tbsp butter.
Add rice and 1/2 cup stock, stirring until absorbed. Keep adding stock 1/2 cup at a time until creamy and al dente, 25-30 min.
Stir in sausage, peas, half the Parmesan, 2 tbsp butter and lemon juice. Top with zest and the remaining Parmesan.

name: One-Pan Beef Enchiladas Verdes

freezer.tip: Assemble, cover tightly and freeze before broiling. Bake from thawed at 375°F, then broil.

steps: Heat the broiler. Slice pepper into strips and scallions (whites apart).
Stir sour cream with hot sauce, thinned with water.
Blister pepper in oil, 5-7 min.
Add beef, scallion whites and spice blend; brown 4-6 min, drain and stir in a quarter of the salsa.
Roll filling into tortillas, set seam-side down in the pan, top with remaining salsa and cheese.
Broil until bubbly, 3-4 min. Drizzle with crema and scallion greens.

name: Honey-Butter BBQ Pork Chops
steps: Peel and dice sweet potatoes; boil until tender, 15-20 min. Mash with sour cream and 1/2 tbsp butter.
Soften 2 tbsp butter and stir in honey and a pinch of salt.
Pat pork dry, season and rub with BBQ seasoning. Sear 4-6 min per side.
Steam green beans, then toss with lemon zest and juice and 1/2 tbsp butter.
Serve pork on the mash topped with honey butter and chili flakes.

name: Kids' Turkey Cucumber Roll-Ups
steps: Cut carrots and cucumber into sticks and slice the apple.
Warm tortillas, spread with mayo, layer turkey and cucumber sticks, then roll up and halve.
Serve with carrots, apple and the three dips, or pack everything separately for lunches.

name: Cheesy Chicken & Guac Sandos
steps: Toast buns. Slice and salt the tomato. Slice chicken into strips.
Toss chicken with half the spice blend, olive oil, salt and pepper, top with cheese and microwave covered until melted, 1-2 min.
Stir guacamole into mayo and spread on the buns.
Fill with cheesy chicken and tomato.

name: Creamy Dreamy Mushroom Cavatappi
steps: Boil salted water. Slice mushrooms and scallions (whites apart).
Brown mushrooms in olive oil, 5-7 min; set aside.
Cook pasta 9-11 min; save 1 cup pasta water.
Melt butter, soften scallion whites, stir in flour 1-2 min, then whisk in milk and 1/4 cup pasta water. Simmer 3-4 min.
Melt in cream cheese, then fold in mushrooms, pasta and garlic herb butter, loosening with pasta water.
Top with Parmesan and scallion greens.
note: Card lists milk as 1 container without a size; 1/2 cup is an estimate.

name: Creamy Cilantro Steak Bowls
steps: Mince garlic and cilantro, slice onion (mince 1 tsp), zest and quarter lime, slice jalapeño and green pepper.
Bloom most of the garlic in oil, add rice, 3/4 cup water and salt; simmer covered 15-18 min.
Stir sour cream, cilantro, minced onion, olive oil, the reserved garlic, lime juice, a little jalapeño and a pinch of cumin; thin with water.
Rub steak with the remaining cumin, salt and pepper; sear 3-6 min per side and rest.
Char pepper and sliced onion, 6-8 min.
Fluff rice with lime zest and butter. Top with veggies, sliced steak, sauce and jalapeño.

name: Creamy Chicken Caesar Lettuce Wraps
steps: Separate the lettuce leaves and chop the small center ones. Dice chicken. Crush the croutons.
Mix dressing, mayo and garlic powder.
Toss in chopped lettuce, chicken and half the Parmesan.
Spoon into lettuce cups and top with croutons and the rest of the Parmesan. You can prep it ahead and keep the leaves separate.

name: Creamy Dijon Dill Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 450°F. Dice potatoes and chop the dill.
Roast oiled potatoes 20-25 min.
Season chicken and sear 3-5 min per side; rest.
Roast oiled broccoli 12-15 min.
In the chicken pan, stir stock concentrate, 2 tbsp water, dill and mustard. Off heat, add sour cream and butter.
Slice chicken and drizzle with the sauce.

name: Ginger Soy Beef Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze the saucy beef; make the rice fresh.

steps: Simmer rice with 1 1/4 cups water and salt, covered, 15-18 min.
Chop cilantro. Mix mayo with sriracha to taste.
Brown beef with salt 3-4 min, then add carrots, sweet soy glaze and ginger sauce until thick, 2-4 min.
Fluff rice with butter. Top with beef, sriracha mayo, fried onions and cilantro.

name: Gouda Egg & Crispy Onion Sandwiches
steps: Crack each egg into its own small bowl, pierce the yolk, season, cover and microwave 60 sec (more in 30-sec bursts if needed).
Stir sour cream with hot sauce to taste. Toast buns.
Spread buns with spicy crema; fill with egg, gouda, a little arugula and half the fried onions.
Toss the rest of the arugula with dressing and top with the remaining onions.

name: Avocado & Pineapple Salsa Breakfast Toasts
steps: Toast bread. Drain pineapple, dice tomato, chop cilantro, quarter lime.
Mix pineapple, tomato, cilantro and a squeeze of lime with salt and pepper.
Spread toast with guacamole, top with salsa and crush chips over the top.

name: Homestyle Chicken & Biscuit Pot Pie

freezer.tip: Freeze the filling only; add fresh biscuits when baking.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Finely dice carrots and celery, dice half the onion, mince garlic.
Brown chicken in an ovenproof pan, 3-5 min; set aside.
Soften carrots, celery and onion 5-7 min, then add garlic and half the thyme.
Melt in 2 tbsp butter, stir in flour 1 min, add 1 1/4 cups water and the stock concentrates and simmer until thick. Off heat, stir in cream cheese, then the chicken.
Split biscuits in half, lay over the filling, brush with melted butter and bake 12-15 min.
Let it cool 5 min before serving.

name: Cheesy Egg & Guacamole Breakfast Sandwiches
steps: Slice half the scallions and the tomato.
Microwave each egg in its own bowl with scallions until set, 1-2 min, then top with cheese.
Toast buns. Mix mayo with hot sauce.
Spread guac on the tops and spicy mayo on the bottoms; fill with egg, tomato and a few chips.

name: Homestyle Turkey & Biscuit Pot Pie

freezer.tip: Freeze the filling only; add fresh biscuits when baking.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Mince half the thyme leaves, finely dice carrots and celery, dice half the onion, mince garlic.
Brown turkey in an ovenproof pan, 3-5 min; set aside.
Soften the veggies 5-7 min, then add garlic and most of the thyme (keep 1/2 tsp).
Melt in 2 tbsp butter, stir in flour 1 min, add 1 1/4 cups water and the stock concentrates and simmer until thick. Off heat, stir in cream cheese and turkey.
Top with split biscuits, brush with melted butter, sprinkle the saved thyme and bake 12-15 min.

name: Gouda, Prosciutto & Fig Jam Sandwiches
steps: Halve and toast the ciabattas. Slice tomato and tear the prosciutto.
Dress arugula with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Spread mayo on the bottoms and fig jam with chili flakes on the tops. Layer arugula, prosciutto, gouda and tomato.

name: Instant Pot BBQ Pulled Pork

freezer.tip: Freeze shredded with some sauce in portions. Reheat with a splash of broth.

steps: Cut pork into 4 chunks and press the rub all over.
Sear in oil on Sauté High, 3-4 min per side, then set aside.
Deglaze the pot with the broth or juice, scraping up the browned bits. Add liquid smoke if using.
Return pork, pour over about 1/2 cup BBQ sauce and pressure cook on High for 60 min. Natural release 10 min, then quick release.
Rest 5-10 min, shred and toss with more sauce. If it isn't fork-tender, cook 5 min more at a time.

name: Mini Chicken Pot Pies

freezer.tip: Freeze baked pies; reheat at 350°F so the crust crisps again.

steps: Heat oven to 375°F and thaw the vegetables.
Stir soup, sour cream, poultry seasoning and pepper, then fold in chicken and vegetables.
Unroll the dough, seal the seams and cut into 8 squares. Press each into a greased muffin cup.
Fill each with about 1/4 cup filling and bake 18-20 min until deep golden. Rest 5 min before lifting out.

name: Salmon Sushi Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Stir rice vinegar with 2 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tsp salt and fold into the warm rice.
Heat oven to 425°F. Top salmon with oil, garlic and salt and bake 11-14 min, then flake.
Simmer 1/2 cup water, soy sauce, 3 tbsp sugar and mirin until slightly thick.
Slice cucumber, avocado and nori.
Build bowls of rice, salmon and vegetables, then finish with sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Crockpot Cream of Mushroom Chicken

freezer.tip: The sauce can split a little; stir well when reheating.

steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika and onion powder and lay it in the slow cooker.
Stir sour cream, soup, broth and garlic, then the mushrooms. Pour over the chicken.
Cook on High 4 hours or Low 6 hours. Top with parsley. Good over rice or egg noodles.

name: Shawarma Bowls

freezer.tip: Freeze the raw chicken in its marinade; it marinates as it thaws.

steps: Whisk oil, juice of 1 lemon, 3 smashed garlic cloves, honey, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, ginger, oregano, 3/4 tsp turmeric and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Marinate the chicken at least 6 hours (up to 2 days).
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until cooked through.
Boil 2 cups water with the bouillon, garlic powder and 1/4 tsp turmeric. Add rice and butter, cover and simmer 15 min, then rest 5 min. Finish with lemon juice.
Whisk yogurt, mayo, a little lemon juice, the remaining garlic (grated), parsley, salt and pepper, thinning with water.
Serve chicken over the yellow rice with white sauce.

name: Oatmeal Energy Balls

freezer.tip: Freeze on a tray, then bag. Thaw 10 min.

steps: Stir everything together until fully combined (it's thick).
Roll into tablespoon-size balls. Chill 20 min first if the mix is too sticky.
Refrigerate a couple of hours for best texture. Keeps several days in the fridge.

name: Banana Bread

freezer.tip: Freeze whole or sliced, wrapped well.

steps: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash bananas with mayo and egg. In another bowl combine flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and pecans.
Stir dry into wet just until combined (the batter is thick).
Bake 60-70 min until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.

name: Smokey Paprika Chicken with Cucumber Tzatziki

freezer.tip: Freeze the raw chicken in its marinade. Make the tzatziki fresh.

ingredients.item: fresh herbs (mint, dill, parsley or cilantro)

steps: Stir oil, paprika, coriander, grated garlic and 1 tbsp lime zest. Coat chicken and marinate 1-12 hours.
Thinly slice cucumber, salt it, drain 10 min, then squeeze dry. Fold into yogurt with lime juice and zest and season.
Salt the chicken and sear in batches, 4-6 min per side, until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve with tzatziki, herbs and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook pasta until al dente; save some pasta water.
Sauté garlic, onion and drained sun-dried tomatoes in 2 tbsp of the tomato oil, 1 min. Add salt, paprika, Italian seasoning and red pepper and cook 2 min.
Add half-and-half and stock and simmer, thinning with pasta water if needed.
Off heat, toss with pasta and top with basil and Parmesan.

name: Teriyaki Tofu
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Press and cube the tofu.
Toss tofu with 3 tbsp cornstarch, the oil and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Bake on parchment 25-30 min, flipping halfway.
Cook the rice.
Simmer 1/2 cup soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger and garlic 5 min. Whisk in 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water and cook 2 min until thick.
Toss tofu with half the sauce and serve over rice with scallions, sesame seeds and more sauce.

name: Farfalle with Spinach, Mushrooms & Caramelized Onions
steps: Caramelize the sliced onions in 1 tbsp oil for about 30 min, starting on high and lowering the heat as they brown. Deglaze with the balsamic and set aside.
Cook mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil with a pinch of salt, 5 min, then wilt in the spinach.
Add half-and-half, bring to a boil, then simmer and melt in 2/3 cup Parmesan and 1/4 tsp salt. Return the onions.
Cook pasta, drain and toss in the sauce. Serve with the remaining Parmesan.

name: Teriyaki Meatballs

freezer.tip: Freeze baked meatballs; make the glaze fresh, or freeze it separately.

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Mix beef, egg, panko, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp garlic and salt; roll about 18 balls and bake 13-18 min.
Warm soy sauce, 1/4 cup water, sherry, brown sugar and the remaining garlic and ginger until the sugar dissolves. Stir in cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water and simmer until glossy.
Toss meatballs in the glaze and top with scallions and sesame seeds. Serve over rice, or keep warm in a slow cooker as an appetizer.

name: Maple Mustard Chicken with Rosemary

freezer.tip: Freeze the raw thighs with the glaze. Roast with fresh veggies.

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil quartered potatoes and carrot chunks 10 min, drain and spread in a greased baking dish.
Score the chicken skin, season and sear skin-side down in a cold nonstick pan brought to medium-high, 4-5 min, then 3-4 min on the other side.
Mix both mustards, maple syrup, 1 tbsp lemon juice, oil and rosemary.
Set chicken skin-up on the vegetables, spread with the glaze and bake 25-30 min to 165°F.

name: Lasagna

freezer.tip: Freeze whole or in portions, unbaked or baked. Thaw overnight, then bake covered at 375°F until hot.

steps: Heat oven to 400°F and grease a deep 9x13 dish.
Brown sausage, beef and onion; drain. Stir in garlic and tomato paste for 1 min.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, 1/3 cup water, brown sugar, parsley, basil, salt and pepper; simmer 10-15 min.
Mix egg, ricotta, 1 1/4 cups Parmesan and pepper.
Layer 2 cups sauce, then 3 noodles, a third of the ricotta and 1 cup mozzarella; repeat twice. Top with the remaining sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake covered 30 min, then uncovered 15-20 min. Rest 15 min before slicing. Halves easily into two 8-inch pans, one to freeze.

name: 15 Minute Chicken and Mushrooms
steps: Cook the egg noodles.
Season chicken with garlic powder, salt and pepper; brown in oil about 2 min per side. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until soft.

Spread the soup over everything. Once bubbling, cover, lower the heat and simmer 5-10 min until the chicken is cooked, adding the peas for the last few minutes. Thin with a splash of milk or water if needed.
Stir in Parmesan and serve over noodles.

name: Chorizo and Potato Tacos with Avocado Salsa Verde

freezer.tip: Freeze the chorizo-potato filling. Make the salsa and tortillas fresh.

steps: Blend the salsa verde with the avocado.
Dice potatoes and brown in oil over medium-high heat.
Add chorizo (casing removed) and one diced onion and cook until the chorizo is done, then add garlic for 1 min.
Serve in warm tortillas with the other onion (diced raw), cilantro and avocado salsa verde.

name: Fried Rice

freezer.tip: Freeze in portions; reheat in a hot pan.

ingredients.item: white rice, cooked the day before (makes about 3 cups)

steps: Soften chopped onion and garlic in oil, 2-3 min.
Add the mixed vegetables and any leftover protein; cook 1-2 min until hot.
Turn up the heat, add the rice and fry 2-3 min until it starts to brown.
Push the rice aside, scramble the eggs in the gap, then stir them through.
Pour over the soy sauce mixed with sesame oil and toss. Top with scallions.

name: Beef Stir Fry

freezer.tip: Freeze the raw sliced beef in the sauce; cook with fresh veggies.

steps: Whisk the sauce: chili paste, paprika, 4 tbsp sesame oil, soy, vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger, broth, red pepper flakes and 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water. Cook the rice.
Toss the beef with 2 tbsp cornstarch, salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp sesame oil over high heat, 2 min; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli and peppers 2 min.
Add the sauce, boil, then simmer 3 min until thick. Return the beef. Serve over rice with scallions. Use less chili paste for a milder version.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken

freezer.tip: Freezes fine, but the veggies soften. Make the rice fresh.

steps: Cook the rice.
Stir curry paste with half the coconut milk on Sauté (or in a saucepan) until bubbly, 1-2 min.
Add thinly sliced chicken, the rest of the coconut milk and broth. Pressure cook on High 4 min then quick release, or simmer covered 5 min.
Stir in fish sauce, sugar, 1 tbsp lime juice, the vegetables and lime leaves; cook until crisp-tender, 3-5 min.
Adjust fish sauce, sugar and lime to taste, add the basil and serve over rice.

name: One Skillet Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken and Orzo
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Rub chicken with 1 tbsp oil, oregano, paprika, red pepper, salt and pepper; sear in an ovenproof skillet 3-5 min per side and set aside.
Cook shallot in butter 3 min, then garlic and orzo until lightly golden.
Deglaze with wine, add 1 1/2 cups water and boil 3-5 min.
Stir in cream, mustard, Parmesan, spinach and sun-dried tomatoes. Nestle the chicken back in.
Bake uncovered 10-15 min until the chicken is cooked. Finish with lemon juice.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup

freezer.tip: Freeze the soup without toppings. Add chips, avocado and sour cream fresh.

steps: Chop the peppers and onion, mince garlic and jalapeño, drain and rinse the beans.
Soften peppers and onion in oil, 5 min, then garlic for 1 min.
Add broth, chicken, spices, jalapeño, tomatoes and corn; simmer 25 min. Add beans to warm through.
Slow cooker: cook everything except chicken, beans and cilantro on Low 2-3 hours, adding chicken and beans for the last 30-45 min.
Stir in cilantro and serve with chips, cheese, avocado, sour cream and lime.

name: Vegan Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Slice eggplant into 1/4-inch rounds, salt generously and drain 30 min. Cook the quinoa.
Soften onion in oil, add garlic and zucchini 1 min, then the red peppers, tomato sauce, herbs, balsamic and sugar; simmer a few minutes.
Pat eggplant dry, brush with oil and broil 4-6 min until browned.
Blend cashews with 1/2 cup water until smooth, then add 1 tbsp lemon juice, 3/4 tsp salt, 1 garlic clove, onion powder and cornstarch.
At 350°F, layer half the eggplant, 1 tbsp breadcrumbs, half the quinoa, sauce and cashew mozzarella in a 9x13; repeat. Bake 20-30 min and top with basil.

name: Sweet Potato Lentil Curry

freezer.tip: Freeze the curry only; make the rice and crispy chickpeas fresh.

steps: Cook the rice. Soften shallots in olive oil 3 min, add ginger and sweet potatoes for 2 min, then the curry paste for 1 min.
Add 3 cups broth, lentils, 3 tbsp soy sauce and peanut butter. Simmer covered 15-20 min (or pressure cook on High 10 min).
Crisp the chickpeas in sesame oil, 5 min, then toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce and sesame seeds.
Stir coconut milk, spinach and lime juice into the curry for 5 min, thinning with broth if needed. Add cilantro.
Serve over rice topped with chickpeas, cilantro and pomegranate.

name: Scrambled Eggs & Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper and cook gently in butter, stirring, until just set.

name: Oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats in milk with a pinch of salt, stirring, 5 min (or microwave 2-3 min).
Top with brown sugar, sliced banana or a spoon of peanut butter.

name: Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt and honey in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight. Top with fruit in the morning. Make 3-4 jars at once for the week.

name: Yogurt Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, fruit and granola, then drizzle with honey.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread, spread with peanut butter and top with sliced banana, plus cinnamon or honey if you like.

name: Egg & Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Toast the muffin.
Fry the egg in butter, breaking the yolk, and add the cheese for the last 30 sec.
Sandwich it together. Add ham or bacon if you have it.

name: Freezer Breakfast Burritos

freezer.tip: Wrap each in foil and freeze. Microwave 2-3 min without the foil.

steps: Crisp the potatoes in oil, and brown the sausage if using.
Scramble the eggs softly and season.
Fill each tortilla with potatoes, eggs, sausage, cheese and a spoon of salsa, then roll tightly.
Eat now or cool, wrap each in foil and freeze. Reheat from frozen: microwave 2-3 min (paper towel, no foil) or bake at 375°F for 25 min in foil.

name: Box-Mix Pancakes

freezer.tip: Freeze in a single layer, then bag. Toast from frozen.

steps: Whisk mix, milk and egg (or follow the box).
Cook 1/4-cup scoops on a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip. Serve with syrup. Extras freeze well for toaster mornings.

name: Fried Egg & Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread and mash avocado on it with salt.
Fry the eggs and lay them on top, with chili flakes if you like.

name: PB&J
steps: Spread one slice with peanut butter and the other with jelly, then close. Add fruit on the side.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with mayo, diced celery, salt and pepper.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

name: Turkey & Cheese Sandwich
steps: Spread bread with mustard or mayo and layer turkey, cheese and lettuce.

name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
steps: Heat the soup with the milk (or water).
Butter the outsides of the bread, fill with cheese and cook over medium until golden on both sides and melted.

name: Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and beans or chicken, then fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan 2-3 min per side until crisp and melted. Serve with salsa.

name: Chicken Salad Wrap
steps: Chop the chicken and mix with mayo, diced celery, fruit, salt and pepper.
Roll into tortillas with lettuce.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
steps: Hard-boil the eggs (cover with water, bring to a boil, then 10 min off the heat covered). Cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with mayo, mustard, salt and pepper, and spread on bread with lettuce.

name: Upgraded Ramen
steps: Boil the noodles with the vegetables.
Stir in the seasoning, crack in the egg and cook 1-2 min, or drop in a soft-boiled egg.
Add any leftover protein for the last minute to warm through.
Top with sliced scallion.

name: Rice & Bean Bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Warm the drained beans with cumin and salt.
Top rice with beans, salsa, cheese and avocado.

name: Make-Ahead Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta in salted water, then rinse cold and drain.
Toss with dressing, chopped vegetables, cheese and meat.
Refrigerate. Keeps 4-5 days; stir in a splash more dressing before eating.
